member.name: T:Foundgine.GraphQL.HotChocolate.FoundgineHotChocolateQueryExecutor
member.summary:
Optional, secure-by-default execution entry point for GraphQL queries hosted on Hot Chocolate. This is the query-side counterpart to Foundgine.MCP.FoundgineMcpTools: it translates GraphQL text using , requires a host-supplied via , and calls directly. GraphQL request payloads can never supply identity, tenant, audience, or warrant material; that context is always established by the host before this class is invoked.
Using this class is optional. remains a pure GraphQL-to- translator with no security opinion, for hosts that want to wire execution themselves.

Translates and executes a GraphQL query. Throws if the host has not established a for this call. GraphQL syntax/translation errors propagate as the same exceptions
would throw directly. Prefer when you want these mapped to stable GraphQL-facing error codes instead of thrown.
